current.text: Portland's projected starting five is Lillard, Morant, Camara, Avdija and Clingan.
Portland is short on forwards. Basically only Avdija and Camara play forward on the roster.
Portland likely needs him for about 34 minutes a night, and his minutes should stay solid.
He needs to lock in at 30 or more minutes to hold fantasy value.
Portland has many high-usage guards: Lillard, Morant, Holiday and Henderson, plus Avdija.
His usage will probably drop this season because of the crowded guard group.
Minutes and usage across Portland's rotation are expected to swing from game to game.
Portland has a new head coach this season.
He shot poorly for most of last season and only shot well in the last six weeks. His steals were also down last season.
With Portland's usage, experts see him mainly as a steals contributor.
Experts put him in tier seven at small forward and call a rank of 101 too high.

durable.text: He is Portland's only real point-of-attack defender.
His shooting runs in peaks and valleys.
He has weak ball handling and is seen as a poor finisher.

note: Camara is a late-round filler. Yahoo values him at 3 USD with an average cost of 1.0 USD (rank 109), ESPN at 0 USD (rank 131), and he went for 4 USD in our league last season. Experts call a rank of 101 too high. His projected line is mostly about 2.0 threes and 1.2 steals, and his 44.5 FG% and 72 FT% cost a little. He hurts no category badly, so he can sit on any build as a 1 to 2 USD pick or a waiver option. Early in the season, check that he starts and plays 30 or more minutes next to Portland's crowded guard group, and whether his late-season shooting holds.
